text:
Asha: Quick async check-in re: Crux escrow renewal w/ VegaCorp — renewal call Fri 11am PT. Did a usage pass for last 30d: overall usage up 18% but noticed a spike of 429/502 webhook errors hitting their prod account around Feb 12-14. Sharing details below.
Jon: Which webhook path? inbound model calls or callback webhook from our side?
Asha: it’s the inbound model webhook (route: /v1/serve/crux). Errors are mostly 429s during hourly batch jobs and intermittent 502s. Log snippet:
```
[2026-02-12 14:12:33] 429 rate_limit: account=vegacorp project=crux svc=serve path=/v1/serve/crux tokens=1200
[2026-02-12 14:12:35] 502 upstream_timeout: conn reset by peer
```
Marco: looks like their dedicated pool is hitting the token-bucket burst limit during batch windows. Ops runbook shows sustained util ~92% for GPU pool-3. We can apply temporary burst or shift some batch jobs. @Priya do they want bursts for reliability or keep strict cost cap?
Priya: I will check the contract notes — they asked for predictable spend in the renewal, but can consider short bursts if we document costs. I’ll ask the AE and confirm today.
Asha: blocker for me: need eng to confirm fallback policy for 502s so we can tell them the risk profile on the call. @Jon can you review canary/rollback settings? Need quick review <30m.
Jon: On it. Quick read: current canary uses rollout window=1m and no automatic fallback to lower-cost variant. Recommendation: extend rollout window to 3m and add automatic fallback to quantized-variant if errors exceed 1%. Pinging PR.
Lena: PR #452 (cs-config) adds the fallback and extends window. I left the test plan in the PR description. @Jon I added you as reviewer.
Jon: Reviewed PR, left a nit on the logging key format but LGTM otherwise. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for their high-reuse prompts — that should cut token load during spikes.
Asha: thanks. Plan: I’ll deploy to staging, run 20m smoke, then schedule prod promotion if stable. For renewal call I need: usage slide + mitigation plan + cost delta for burst. @Priya you take pricing/cost slide? @Lena add one-liner on SLO impact.
Priya: I’ll add a cost slide by EOD and confirm whether they’ll accept a small temporary buffer in the contract.
Marco: Ops will enable a temporary burst cap on pool-3 tomorrow 06:00 PT (before their heavy jobs start). I’ll update when applied.
deploy-bot: staging deploy started for cs-config at 2145123600 by Asha.
Asha: Staging deploy succeeded at 2145123660, running 20m monitor now. If stable I will propose prod promotion tomorrow morning.
Jon: :thumbsup: If prod promo needed sooner ping me and I’ll stand by for rollback.
Priya: will send an invite for Fri 11am PT renewal call once I confirm AE availability.
Marco: Ops update: burst applied 2145123700 -> initial metrics show 60% drop in 429s during one sample hour. Monitoring continues.
Asha: Great — thanks everyone. I’ll close the loop after Friday call and post outcome here. If anyone sees regressions ping me directly.
